work_unit: Correct the archive-owned privacy defect in the direct English/Germanic decision-log copies on both required provenance DOI lineages

authority_and_cursor.authority: Archive-maintenance responsibility for privacy remediation, exact non-curatorial preservation, dual-DOI provenance, append-only error history, and public byte readback
authority_and_cursor.source_coordinates: Private append-only source log: 477 records / 3191133 bytes / SHA-256 067EA74FD007F45207E7E8504648FDC4683DB3CCA2ECD9A205299988B545974C; methodology predecessor 21778949; replication predecessor 21778962
authority_and_cursor.continuation_cursor: Tracked same-concept drafts 21779952 and 21779957 exist. Generate the deterministic privacy-clean projection only after this decision is appended, then upload, publish, and anonymously read back both successors.

choice: Preserve the raw append-only source unchanged in private custody and in immutable predecessor history; create a deterministic public projection that retains every record in exact order while replacing only private path roots, private state-directory segments, the private project email if present, and internal task identifiers; bind every replacement by record, JSON path, byte length, and SHA-256 in an event-level ledger; replace the raw public log and provenance ZIP/manifest on new versions under the two existing concepts; front the privacy note, clean log, ledger, validation, and this adverse-history decision record.

alternatives.alternative: Leave the verbatim shared log current because its decisions are valuable provenance
alternatives.reason: Audit value does not authorize disclosure of historical absolute operator paths or internal task identifiers; a transformed public projection can preserve every substantive record.

alternatives.alternative: Delete the predecessor versions or rewrite their published bytes
alternatives.reason: Published Zenodo versions are immutable evidence. They must remain adverse history while a clean successor becomes current.

alternatives.alternative: Drop path-bearing records or summarize the log into selected highlights
alternatives.reason: That would curate away decisions, errors, reversals, and continuation evidence. The projection must retain all records and transform only private tokens.

alternatives.alternative: Mint replacement methodology or replication concepts
alternatives.reason: Both existing concept lineages are authoritative and already have tracked same-concept successor drafts.

evidence.finding: The 477-record raw public copy contains 421 absolute private-user path-root occurrences, 3 private Codex-state directory segments, and 17 internal task identifiers. No SGA reader or producer logbook byte is implicated.

Methodology predecessor 21778949 remains published under concept 10.5281/zenodo.21124403 with 99 files / 4990185641 bytes; tracked successor draft 21779952 was created only after exact predecessor, latest-head, and no-untracked-draft guards passed.

Replication predecessor 21778962 remains published under concept 10.5281/zenodo.20461174 with 64 files / 8586618 bytes; tracked successor draft 21779957 was created only after exact predecessor, latest-head, and no-untracked-draft guards passed.

motivation: Correct an archive-created disclosure without destroying history, mutating source custody, weakening mathematical auditability, or selecting only favorable records.
uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: The raw predecessor log is already public in immutable versions 21778949 and 21778962 and cannot be erased; the successors must identify those versions as adverse history.
The exact 2296-byte controlling dual-DOI file includes explicitly mandated operational identifiers and remains byte-exact as the sole declared identifier-pattern exception in the provenance ZIP.
Publication and anonymous readback are not claimed by this pre-publication decision record; they remain the next required transaction.

consequences.source_custody: The private append-only source log remains unchanged and is appended only through the locked helper.
consequences.public_projection: Every decision ID and record order will be retained; no decision, error, reversal, or continuation record may be omitted.
consequences.zenodo: Only tracked records 21779952 and 21779957 under existing concepts may be used; no duplicate concept or parallel draft is authorized.
consequences.corpus_bytes: No reader, translation, TeX, source, mathematical, FAC, or GAGA payload is changed or added by this remediation.

supersedes: the privacy acceptance claim for the direct raw decision-log object on records 21778949 and 21778962
preserves: all 477 existing decision records in exact order
the raw append-only source in private custody
records 21778949 and 21778962 as immutable adverse history
